name: Free Tier Music Restrictions
description: Free users say they cannot freely choose, skip, replay, or seek through songs without Premium.

name: Too Many Ads
description: Listeners say ads are too frequent or loud, interrupting music playback and making the free experience frustrating.

name: General App Dissatisfaction
description: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app without identifying a specific problem.

name: Disappointing Recent Updates
description: Users say recent updates have made the app worse or unusable without specifying a particular problem.

name: Missing or hard-to-use playback controls
description: Users say updates removed or made it difficult to use basic playback controls, such as repeating songs, replaying a few seconds, and disabling autoplay.

name: Too Much Pressure to Go Premium
description: Users complain that Spotify increasingly puts features or ads behind Premium and pushes users to pay.

name: Unable to Log In
description: Users say they cannot access their accounts because the app will not accept their password.

name: Lyrics Missing from Some Songs
description: Lyrics are unavailable for some songs.

name: Missing Music in the Catalog
description: Users say the catalog lacks songs and has limited gospel music.

name: Political and Values-Based Boycotts
description: Reviewers say they oppose Spotify over its perceived support for LGBTQ+ people or an alleged Quran-burning connection and intend to boycott or uninstall the app.

name: App crashes or gets stuck loading
description: The app crashes on launch or remains stuck on the loading screen, preventing users from opening it.

name: Forced Shuffle Disrupts Playlists
description: Songs in playlists play randomly, disrupting listeners’ preferred song order.

name: Recommendations Feel Less Fresh
description: The recommendations include fewer songs and seem less up to date than before.

name: Downloads Get Stuck in Background
description: Song downloads get stuck while running in the background.

name: Offline Listening Not Working
description: Downloaded music is not available for offline listening.

name: Music Adjustment Bug
description: The music adjustment feature does not work properly.

name: Assistant Says Playing but No Music
description: Google Assistant reports that a Spotify playlist is playing, but no songs play.

name: Unable to Connect to the Internet
description: The app cannot connect to the internet, preventing playback.

name: Playback Stops Mid-Song
description: Music stops halfway through a song and may restart with a different song instead of resuming.

name: Unpopular Home Screen Redesign
description: The reviewer dislikes the updated home screen.
